data.name: Camellina
data.gender_notes: Camellina is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin word 'camellus', meaning young camellia. In Christianity, this name is associated with the virtue of youthfulness and renewal. The name Camellina carries the meaning “Young camellia” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Camellina usually hope their child will grow to embody young camellia and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Camellina total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_hebrew.name: קמילינה
in_hebrew.meaning: קמילינה נגזר מקמל משמעותו שיח תהילה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: קמילינה הוא שם נוצרי שמקורו בשם הצמח קמל, שמשמעותו שיח תהילה. השם קמל מגיע מעברית ומתאר צמח שמריח טוב ומשמש למטרות רפואיות. השם קמילינה הוא נגזר של השם קמל ומוסיף לו משמעות של חסד ומתיקות.

in_greek.name: Καμελλίνα
in_greek.long_meaning: Καμελλίνα είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα που προέρχεται από το λατινικό όνομα Camellus, που σημαίνει λιβελούλη το καθαρό. Το όνομα Camellus πιθανότατα συνδέεται με το γένος των Καμέλιων, ένα είδος λουλουδιού. Στην εκκλησία των πρώτων χριστιανών, το όνομα Καμελλίνα πιθανότατα συμβόλιζε την αγνότητα και την πνευματική ομορφιά.

in_latin.name: Camellina
in_latin.long_meaning: Camellina is a Christian name derived from Camellus, meaning pure camellia. The name likely originated from the Camellia genus, a type of flower. In early Christian tradition, Camellina may have symbolized spiritual purity and beauty, reflecting the virtues valued by the early Christian community.

in_english.name: Camellina
in_english.long_meaning: Camellina is a Christian name with roots in Hebrew and Greek, derived from Camellus, meaning pure camellia. The name symbolizes spiritual purity, gentleness, and beauty. Historically, Camellina may have been used in early Christian tradition to signify a person's commitment to faith and virtue. Today, Camellina is used across Christian cultures to signify a person's connection to their faith and heritage.
